disorder-name.detail: Autism sample clinical cohort from ABIDE.
disorder-name.supporting_text: In a subsequent step, we applied the hierarchical Bayesian models to 482 individuals with autism from the same data set, out of which 430 were male.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Autism cohort drawn from the ABIDE data set.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: The ABIDE consortium (http://preprocessed-connectomesproject.org/abide/) was founded to facilitate research and collaboration on autism spectrum disorders by data aggregation and sharing.

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from male/female subgroup statistics; range reported for autism sample.
age.supporting_text: Autism sample : Age male subjects: M = 16.9., SD = 6.5. Age female subjects: M = 15.1, SD = 5.8., range = 8-39;

sex.detail: Female count and percentages calculated from total N=482 and male N=430.
